items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Brian Doyle Murray, Billy’s brother, had this idea

ctx.x: Well you found yourself on camera in part of —

Oh yeah how’d I get on camera. Well yeah so I left, they took that pilot off the shelf and I ended up leaving SNL in the second season and going to Hollywood and making a show that played called “Year at the Top” it didn’t get picked up, came back got my old job back. But now I had some ammunition. I had seen this guy Don Kirchner. He had a show at the time, “Don Kirchner’s Rock Concert.” He emceed it in a really funny deadpan way. I am now back at SNL kind of participating in writing sessions. And Brian Doyle…
with him, you know, and I can do an impression of him.” And he said, “Great.” And that’s how I sneaked on the air for the first time.
